_note: WhatsApp business-initiated messages need templates pre-approved by Meta. A missed call does NOT open a 24-hour session — the customer rang a phone, they did not message you — so the first message out must be an approved template. Submit these in Meta Business Manager under category UTILITY. Marketing-flavoured wording gets rejected or throttled, so there is deliberately no selling here. The active template name is chosen via WHATSAPP_MISSED_CALL_TEMPLATE in .env — this file is documentation/reference for what to submit, not read by the server at runtime.

missed_call_immediate.body: Sorry we missed your call — this is {{1}}. Reply here with what you need and your area, and {{2}} will call you straight back.
missed_call_immediate._why: Sent within seconds of the missed call, while they still remember dialling. No pitch, no links, no apology paragraph. The single job is to keep them from ringing the next electrician in the search results.

missed_call_after_hours.body: Sorry we missed your call — this is {{1}}. We're closed right now but reply with what you need and your area, and {{2}} will call you first thing.
missed_call_after_hours._why: Same message, honest about timing. Promising an immediate callback at 11pm and not delivering is worse than saying 'first thing'.

_conversation._note: Free-form replies sent once the customer has messaged us and a 24-hour service window is open. {{1}}/{{2}} are filled in by lib/conversation.mjs, not by Meta.
_conversation.ask_problem: No worries — what's the issue you're facing, and what area are you in?
_conversation.ask_area: Sure. What area are you located in?
_conversation.ask_name: Thanks. May I have your name?
_conversation.ask_urgency: Thanks {{1}}, do you need someone today, or is another day okay?
_conversation.lead_confirmation: Thanks {{1}}! Got it — {{2}} will be in touch shortly.
_conversation.emergency_safety: Thanks — that sounds urgent, {{1}} is being alerted now. If you can smell burning or see sparking, switch off at the mains if it's safe to reach, and don't touch anything else.
